sources.disposition: Rejects preliminary 200 × 150 km ellipse as incompatible with negative chords and Cassini; joint 2018 May 12/20 model suggests equatorial radius 85 km with possible crater. Full 3D solution ongoing, so neither speculative crater nor early 205.6 × 141.3 km outline is baked.
Recent confirmation of non-spherical Cassini outline and only 4–6 native pixels across. No unambiguous surface markings, no terrain map selected.
